Graham Capital Management LP Position in Amazon Com (AMZN) Trimmed by $305,106 as Shares Rose; As Aecom (ACM) Share Price Declined, Quantitative Investment Management Has Cut Position
June 17, 2018 - By Stephen Andrade
Kenneth Tropin decreased its stake in Amazon Com Inc (AMZN) by 24.03% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Graham Capital Management Lp sold 211 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.80% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Kenneth Tropin held 667 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $965,000, down from 878 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Graham Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Amazon Com Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $832.64B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.46% or $7.89 during the last trading session, reaching $1715.97. About 3.88M shares traded. Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN) has risen 62.09% since June 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 49.52% the S&P500.
